about_the_game:
Shenaniguns is a top-down, real time multiplayer shooter. Each time you spawn, you get 2-3 weapons (depending on the gamemode) to battle your friends!

With 100+ weapons such as pistols, shotguns, snipers, grenades, turrets, portal guns, concentrated uranium, grappling hooks, 4" tungsten cubes, industrially sized water guns, gasoline, pepper spray, gambling, galvanised square steel, drones, RPGs...

And much, much more, including special abilities and enchantments!

Gamemodes

  • Free for all - Kill as many people as possible!

  • Team deathmatch - Two even teams, red and blue!

  • 3 Weapons - Self-explanatory

  • Capture the flag - Capture the other team's flag for extra points!

  • Capture the point - Stand on points around the map to gain points for your team!

  • Boss battles - Such as Vectah! More coming soon

  • Gun gaem - Your weapons you get are tied to your points

  • CHAOS - Explode when you die, move faster, 3 weapons, closer spawning, bigger fires, bigger battles, and a whole lot of nuclear waste

Shenaniguns is still being actively developed. You can test it out in the free demo!

Want to keep track of the game's development? Follow the store page, or join our Discord (link's on the right)

  • Processor: 2.4 GHz 64-Bit Quad Core – Intel/AMD processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Xe/GeForce RTX 2060/RX 5600 XT or above
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
